<thought>We need a template that performs the Wolff‑Kishner reduction (ketone → alkane). The forward reaction breaks a ketone functional group, forming an alkane. I’ll search the template catalog for reactions that break a “ketone” and form an “alkane”, using a simple ketone (propanone) as the target molecule to retrieve a suitable template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkane"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
